items.question: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits which enzyme?
items.explanation: Aspirin irreversibly acetylates cyclooxygenase (COX), reducing prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis.

items.question: Mechanism of action of fluoroquinolones?
items.explanation: Fluoroquinolones inhibit DNA gyrase (topoisomerase II) and topoisomerase IV, blocking bacterial DNA replication.

items.question: Rituximab acts against which cell surface marker?
items.explanation: Rituximab is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody depleting B cells, used in lymphoma and autoimmune disease.

items.question: Drug of choice for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia is?
items.explanation: Cotrimoxazole (trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole) is first-line for PCP treatment and prophylaxis in immunocompromised patients.

items.question: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) primarily ensures?
items.explanation: GMP ensures products are consistently produced and controlled to quality standards appropriate to their intended use.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 16 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Autacoids and NSAIDs)
Q: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits which enzyme?
Ans: Cyclooxygenase
Why: Aspirin irreversibly acetylates cyclooxygenase (COX), reducing prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Chemotherapy)
Q: Mechanism of action of fluoroquinolones?
Ans: Inhibit DNA gyrase/topoisomerase
Why: Fluoroquinolones inhibit DNA gyrase (topoisomerase II) and topoisomerase IV, blocking bacterial DNA replication.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Immunopharmacology)
Q: Rituximab acts against which cell surface marker?
Ans: CD20
Why: Rituximab is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody depleting B cells, used in lymphoma and autoimmune disease.

🌍 *FMGE* (Chemotherapy)
Q: Drug of choice for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia is?
Ans: Cotrimoxazole
Why: Cotrimoxazole (trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole) is first-line for PCP treatment and prophylaxis in immunocompromised patients.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Pharmaceutical Industry)
Q: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) primarily ensures?
Ans: Consistent quality of manufactured drugs
Why: GMP ensures products are consistently produced and controlled to quality standards appropriate to their intended use.
